title: Funnel data privacy and security
markdown:
# Secure data handling. Always.

At Funnel, we take privacy, security and integrity seriously. To help our customers meet their compliance and security requirements, we work according to the most common security standards and best practices within the areas of people, processes, and technology.

![](https://funnel.io/hs-fs/hubfs/Union.png?width=400&height=400&name=Union.png)

![Ic_checkmark](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Ic_checkmark.svg)

#### ISO 27001 certified

We are ISO 27001 certified and compliant with the data protection and privacy frameworks outlined in the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

![Ic_checkmark](https://funnel.io/hubfs/Ic_checkmark.svg)

#### Choose your data region

Funnel also allows customers to choose their data region (within the EU, US, or globally) to meet their specific data hosting needs.

### Choice of data region

To meet our customers' preferences on data residency, we offer the possibility to choose whether their data is hosted in either the US or EU for select subscriptions. This also provides peace of mind to customers acting as, or for, agencies with customers wanting to host their data in the EU or the US. Regardless of the data region, we are fully compliant with applicable privacy frameworks and meet the high-performance needs of our clients.

[View subscriptions](https://funnel.io/pricing)

![lock-stars-black-white](https://529308.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/529308/lock-stars-black-white.png)

#### GDPR and CCPA

Funnel is fully compliant with applicable data privacy legislation, such as GDPR in the EU and CCPA in California, USA. For further information, please see our terms and conditions.

![iso-27001-black-white](https://529308.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/529308/iso-27001-black-white.png)

#### ISO

Funnel's security program is certified according to the ISO 27001 standard, which means that we work structurally and long-term to protect our organization and our customers' data. Our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) ensures that we have appropriate security measures in place and that these measures are continuously evaluated and improved.

![soc-2-black-white](https://529308.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/529308/soc-2-black-white.png)

#### SOC 2

Funnel has undergone a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation. SOC 2 is an attestation framework developed by the American organization AICPA that is perfectly suited for SaaS providers. The purpose of the framework is to be able to ensure that an organization has adequate internal controls in place to protect its customers' data.

Further details about Funnel’s security program can be found under the [Infosec overview.](https://funnel.io/funnel-information-security-overview)
